test.result: 3 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. The report requires TRAIN-only candidates on one content-addressed training snapshot, computes the five-objective frontier, records reasons for every non-selected candidate and refuses archive rewrites.

implemented: Five declared criteria are net return and capacity (maximize), drawdown, turnover and complexity (minimize).
Validation/holdout candidate labels, mixed training hashes and mixed training end dates are rejected.
The selected candidate must be on the Pareto frontier and requires a human-supplied selection reason.
Dominated candidates list their dominators; non-selected frontier candidates carry explicit alternative reasons.
JSON decision archive is immutable and idempotent for exact retries.
blockers: The repository has not supplied a new, verified, same-snapshot training metric set for all candidates.
Metric provenance, capacity model and complexity scoring are supplied by the caller and are not recalculated by this reporting layer.
No validation result or profitability claim is inferred from a training-only Pareto report.
scope_note: Training-only report generation and immutable candidate decision archive are implemented; measured candidate coverage and metric provenance remain outstanding.
